name: SamState
meaning: sam+0x80, written by Sam_SetState. Names 1,2,3,4,6,9 follow the developers' Enter*State strings / SAM_STT_FOLLOWNODES; others invented.

name: SAM_STT_IDLE
meaning: initial, anim 6

name: SAM_STT_FOLLOWNODES
meaning: follow nav-graph node path (original name from exe string)

name: SAM_STT_REACHGOAL
meaning: run straight at the goal

name: SAM_STT_SEARCHNEARESTNODE
meaning: 45-degree heading search toward goal/nearest nav edge

name: SAM_STT_REACHNODE
meaning: run to a single nav node

name: SAM_STT_FADE
meaning: sets fade fields/globals; never entered by any Sam_SetState call (dead)

name: SAM_STT_LOOKAFTER
meaning: stationary guard with head sweep

name: SAM_STT_LOOKAFTER_TIMED
meaning: timed look-after pause during patrol (+0x86e)

name: SAM_STT_CATCHWOLF
meaning: grab/hit animation playing

name: SAM_STT_FOLLOWTRAJECTORY
meaning: patrol at 200 u/s with patrol detection

name: SAM_STT_INVESTIGATE
meaning: walk to msg-0x481 point

name: SAM_STT_CIN01
meaning: MODE 0x400: face Wolf, launch CIN01 cinematic (0x5631d0), become patroller

name: SAM_STT_KNOCKEDOUT
meaning: fall / lying (DEATHDURATIONMS) / get up, then chase

name: SAM_STT_PICKUP
meaning: pick-up anim 0xF; on end grabs fetch object

name: SAM_STT_LIFT
meaning: anim 0x10 after pick-up, then search toward goal

name: SAM_STT_PUTDOWN
meaning: anim 0x11, yaw forced 0x800, then state 0x10

name: SAM_STT_AFTERPUTDOWN
meaning: anim 0x12; restores normal anim table; may go to 0x15

name: SAM_STT_CATCHDONE
meaning: anim 0x13 after the catch; no handler (terminal until reset)

name: SAM_STT_FOLLOWTRAJECTORY_FAST
meaning: msg 0x4A: trajectory at 1100 u/s, no detection

name: SAM_STT_HITROBOT
meaning: anim 0x16, wait actionTimer then go home

name: SAM_STT_DISCOVERWOLF
meaning: entered from pre-pass when msg 0x482 arg == Wolf while fetching the Wolf; anim 8 once, may escalate to anim 0x15 + camera (inferred meaning)

name: SAM_STT_ANGRY
meaning: anim 0x15 with reaction camera, then red alert chase

name: SAM_STT_WATCHROBOT
meaning: MODE 0x80000: stand by robot WATCHROBOTTIMEMS then Sam_TryHitRobot
